reporting-org.narrative: The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria

title.narrative: Program to strengthen, decentralize and improve the national response to HIV/AIDS in Niger - Niger (01-Jul-2015-31-Dec-2017)

description.narrative: Niger, HIV, Cellule Nationale de Coordination Technique de la Riposte Nationale au Sida et aux Hépatites (CN/CTRN)This program has the following goals: To ensure efficient governance of the national response against HIV/AIDS. To improve the quality of life of at least 80% of PLHIV enrolled in HIV care and at least 20% of OVCs identified by 2017. To reduce new infections by 50% by 2017. The objectives of this program are: At least 80% of children and adults living with HIV are alive 12 months after initiation of ARV theraphy by 2017. At least 80% of each of the identified most at risk populations (sex workers, MSMs, migrant workers and prisoners) adopt reduced risk behaviors by 2017. Community organizations effectively participate in the national response against HIV/AIDS. Human rights of at least 80% of PLHIV enrolled for care and treatment are effectively protected by 2017. Mother to child transmission of HIV is reduced by at least 5% by 2017 among children born from HIV positive mothers. Strategic, high quality information regarding STDs and HIV/AIDS are produced, available and used in the national response against HIV/AIDS

title.narrative: Impact indicators targets and results for NER-H-CNCTRNP01
Percentage of young people aged 15-24 who are living with HIV
Percentage of other vulnerable populations (specify) who are living with HIV
Estimated percentage of children newly infected with HIV from mother-to-child transmission among women living with HIV delivering in the past 12 months
Percentage of sex workers who are living with HIV
Percentage of men who have sex with men who are living with HIV
Outcome indicators targets and results for NER-H-CNCTRNP01
Percentage of adults and children with HIV, known to be on treatment 12 months after initiation of antiretroviral therapy
Percentage of men reporting the use of a condom the last time they had anal sex with a male partner
Percentage of sex workers reporting using a condom with their most recent client
Percentage of women attending antenatal care
Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for NER-H-CNCTRNP01
Percentage of MSM that have received an HIV test during the reporting period and know their results
Percentage of sex workers that have received an HIV test during the reporting period and know their results
Percentage of sex workers reached with HIV prevention programs - defined package of services
Percentage of MSM reached with HIV prevention programs - defined package of services
Percentage of infants born to HIV-positive women receiving a virological test for HIV within 2 months of birth
Percentage of people living with HIV currently receiving antiretroviral therapy
Percentage of HIV-positive patients who were screened for TB in HIV care or treatment settings
Percentage of HIV-positive registered TB patients given anti-retroviral therapy during TB treatment
Percentage of HMIS or other routine reporting units submitting timely reports according to national guidelines
Percentage of pregnant women who know their HIV status
Percentage of HIV-positive pregnant women who received antiretrovirals to reduce the risk of mother-to-child transmission
